definitions.full: H7947. shalab [ שָׁלַב ] verb Pu`al be bound, joined (Late Hebrew Punic = Biblical Hebrew; שְׁלִיבָה rung of ladder; Aramaic שְׁלִיבִין apparently only 1Kin 7:28-29 , , ravine, narrow path between mountains ; Arabic is seize, carry off, by force ); — Participle feminine plural מְשֻׁלָּבֹת Exod 26:17 tenons joined each to ( אֶל ) its fellow, 36:22 (both P).
